title: RPG MAKER MZ Plugin: Treasure Hunt minigame

posts.author: Undermax
posts.body:
Treasure Hunt Minigame Plugin
Add excitement and adventure to your game with the Treasure Hunt minigame!
Key Features
Engaging Treasure Hunt Gameplay:
- Players search for hidden treasures within a grid of cells.
- Limited Moves: Players have a limited number of moves to uncover cells and find treasures.
- Hint System: Players can use a highlight to locate nearby treasures.
- Reward System: You can get Items Weapons and Armors in the Demo Version.
More features added using the Full version.
- Customizable Game Parameters: Configure grid size, number of moves, and more!
- Easy Plugin Command: Initialize the game with a simple plugin command making integration seamless.
- Flexible Settings: Adjust game parameters to fit your design needs.
- Visual Customization: Customize the appearance of the game elements to match your game's aesthetic.
The DEMO version is completely free and you can now download it from my Itch.io page!
If you liked the plugin, you can use the FULL version which offers more features and advanced settings
.

Click to expand...
Hello. It's really quite strange. Did you try installing the plugin in a new, clean project?
You could also try regenerating the "plugins.js" file information.
To do so, you can try the following:
A- Open the plugin manager in RPG Maker MZ, select all plugins (Ctrl + A), right-click with the mouse, and click "Refresh" and "OK," then save the changes.
B- While the plugin manager is open, delete the "plugins.js" file from the "js" folder in your project's root directory, click "OK" to save changes, and then press CTRL + S to save again; this will regenerate an updated "plugins.js" file.
I can also provide a template with the plugin already working. If it still doesn’t work, then it might be an issue with your device, and we would need to explore other options.
Best regards.
